hero.title: Apple iPhone Duo Launches at $1,999 as Samsung Defends Foldable Phone Lead
hero.excerpt: Apple has launched the $1,999 iPhone Duo, entering the foldable market as Samsung defends its lead with the Galaxy Z Fold8 and years of experience.
hero.excerptPart2: Apple has finally entered the foldable smartphone market, unveiling the iPhone Duo in a move that could significantly reshape one of the industry's most closely watched categories. The company announced the device on September 9, 2026, making it the first foldable iPhone after years of speculation and putting Apple directly against Samsung, which has spent seven generations building its position in the category. Starting at $1,999 in the United States, the iPhone Duo is aimed squarely at the premium end of the market and will compete most directly with Samsung's latest Galaxy Z Fold8. Reuters reported that analysts expect Apple's arrival to give the relatively small foldable market a substantial boost while challenging Samsung's established leadership.
